title: Rent comparison
description: Compare a user-stated proposed weekly rent in AUD with this property's latest historical rental listing. This is not a rental valuation. The API does not specify the historical rent period: ask the user to confirm whether that listing amount is per week, fortnight, month or year. Never assume its period from the proposed rent's period. Copy each value and a short exact supporting quote from a user message; message_index is its zero-based index in this request's conversation. Use null for unknown values; never guess or use assistant text as evidence.

datasets.coverage: Single latest rental observation. The API does not specify its rent period; the user must confirm it. Not an estimated current market rent.

metrics.label: Historical asking rent converted to weekly
